title: tests: on a slow CI runner two `export-to-react-compiles` tests (and two `check-object-metadata-write-doors` tests) cross the 15 s `testTimeout`, so a slow leg that finishes still ends red
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured defect on a public door, the required `Test` aggregate.

- **Filed by:** objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post #5560) · `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`. ⛔ Not a claim.
- **Reader who acts:** objectui triage, to grade and route. Then the seat that claims it.
- **Why now:** the finding rode on objectui#12384, the family's carrier. objectui#12384's PR #12399 (16 legs, Tier H) closes that card with `Fixes`, so the finding needs a carrier of its own. The contract review `6181973332` on PR #12399 names the same gap.

`reach:` the required `Test` aggregate on objectui PRs and in the merge queue, whenever a leg lands on a slow runner. objectui#12384's reading measured slow runners at 1.6x to 2.0x per file on 2026-10-14.

## Measured (the reading `6181333653` on objectui#12384, and the build report `6181669972`)

- Job 116029528393 (PR #12383, `Test (shard 1/12)`, a slow VM): two tests in `packages/vscode-extension/src/__tests__/export-to-react-compiles.test.ts` failed at 17,283 ms and 17,648 ms against `testTimeout: 15000`, one second before that leg was cancelled. Its same-head re-run, job 116040360598, ran the same two tests at 8,992 ms and 10,049 ms.
- Two tests in `check-object-metadata-write-doors.test.ts` run 8,533 ms and 8,540 ms on a normal VM, with no per-test override. At the measured 1.6x to 2.0x they cross 15 s.
- With the 16-leg plan, a slow leg no longer hits the 20-minute cap. So these tests become the failure a slow runner produces: a leg that finishes red, not cancelled.

## Acceptance (proposed, for triage to confirm)

- Root-cause each test's cost: what it compiles or spawns, and whether that work is needed per test. Make the test cheap enough to hold a ≥2x margin under the existing `testTimeout`.
- ⛔ No `testTimeout` raise, ⛔ no skip, ⛔ no quarantine, ⛔ no retry (objectui `AGENTS.md`, the test discipline section: find the race, do not tune the timeout).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `export-to-react-compiles test timeout slow runner testTimeout 15000` → 4 hits, all closed. Two are the same class on other files (#8380 `check-unused-dependencies`, #8074 `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, each fixed for its own test). #7862 is about Export to React's output, and #6768 about mocks. None covers these two files.

Dedupe words: testTimeout; export-to-react-compiles; slow runner; near budget; check-object-metadata-write-doors.
